answer: Each new identity names a payout beneficiary, and its bond scales with the count already pointing there: 100 POA first, 400 second, one million at the hundredth. A hundred clones on one wallet lock 34 million POA in vesting; a hundred separate operators lock 10,000. The seed names one beneficiary per epoch to audit; one failure forfeits the whole stack rather than the failing identity, and clones cannot be insured apart. Separate clean wallets surrender that custody. A falcon riding a thermal pays for every metre with lift already spent, and one bad pulse drops the flock at the zenith.
